$comment: Validates curated/supplement/supplement-<ppm>.json -- a raw, secondary input (not the primary standard/header), never validated against api-schema.json directly. See curated/README.md.

additionalProperties.description: Keyed by function name (e.g. 'mpi_send'); each value maps a dotted field path to a supplement entry for that field.

value.description: The proposed value, same type as the target field would hold in a real entry.

method.description: 'web': a fresh external lookup. 'condensed': paraphrased/trimmed from text that already exists in this PPM's own vendored primary input (e.g. NVSHMEM's real **Description** block, MPI's real tex prose) -- correct content, wrong shape (too long/multi-sentence) for the target field, not independently recalled. 'general_knowledge': recalled without consulting the primary source's own text for this specific value.

source_url.description: For 'web': the URL, required non-null. For 'condensed': a repo-relative path into external-inputs/<ppm>/ (optionally with a line number or #section anchor), required non-null. Null for 'general_knowledge'.

retrieved.description: ISO 8601 date. Required non-null when method is 'web' (a live external fetch has a retrieval moment worth recording). Null for 'condensed' (the vendored file's own version/README already pins its provenance) and 'general_knowledge'.

note.description: Why this value is safe to propose without the primary source's own confirmation -- required for every entry, all methods.
